label: Concrete support at every admitted world ascends in esse
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: for every admitted world v and concrete candidates a and b, if a exists at v and stands to b in the selected relation at v, then a is more in esse than b, in the same supplied comparative. No necessity restriction and no selected world. A strengthening of both the actual-grounding ascent premise at each world and the ascent premise between necessary concreta (verified: necessaryAscentOfEverywhere, actualAscentOfEverywhere); strictness not certified.
